title: Home Routine Round
hook: Finish the loop without chasing perfection.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D daily-routine storybook, simple home actions and objects, clean morning-evening scenes; visual identity: Home Routine Round

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child helping reset household items
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Home Routine Round a reset-loop song: use, clean, refill, return, prepare next time—especially cups, lunchbox, towels, soap, bottle, zipper and charts; repetition is practical, not perfectionistic.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child sees routines as loops that reduce searching and contamination, while heat/powered tasks remain adult managed.
